deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (same date for US and non-US applicants).

funding.value: All accepted full-time PhD students in the Rutgers biomedical PhD programs receive a stipend plus tuition, health insurance and fees.
funding.quote: All accepted full-time Ph.D. students will receive a competitive stipend along with full payment of tuition, health insurance, and general fees.

also.quote: Financial aid is provided to highly qualified students, and typically includes a stipend to cover living expenses and remission of tuition fees.

entry_route.value: An undergraduate GPA of at least B is the stated academic threshold; no master's is mentioned as required.
entry_route.quote: A student must have an undergraduate cumulative grade-point average of at least B to be considered for admission.
